# Nivra 0.1.0-alpha.8

## Observable AI work

- Nivra now shows the active agent stage, elapsed time and last activity in the top bar, chat panel and Game Development cockpit.
- The status distinguishes active work, waiting for approval and a possible stalled task.
- Command and Unity approval cards include a short explanation of what the agent intends to do after execution.

## Deeper Unity control

- Codex and Claude can control Unity through Nivra Bridge for scenes, GameObjects, hierarchy, transforms, components, serialized properties, prefabs, materials, tags, layers, build settings, player builds, Play Mode, Console validation and Scene View captures.
- Advanced Editor automation can use temporary Editor scripts and controlled Unity menu-item execution while remaining subject to Nivra access levels and approvals.
- Unity actions update the visible agent stage until the Editor returns a result.

## Project continuity

- Reopening a project restores open and unsaved files, cursor and scroll position, workbench tabs, active chat, Game Development state, selected Unity object and layout.
- A new File menu provides Open Project, Open in New Window, Recent Projects, Save Project Session, Save All, Close Project and Exit.
- Project state is stored outside the repository.

## Readability and layout

- New window presets for 4:3, 16:9, 16:10 and maximized layouts.
- UI scaling from 90% to 175%.
- Separate 4:3, 16:9, 16:10 or fill setting for the Unity Scene preview.

## Reliability

- Saving before close or update preserves unsaved editor buffers and the complete project session.
- The publisher safely backs up and repairs a dirty public release repository without deleting ignored private signing material.
